# Jolt Physics - fetched at build time

joltc (`joltc/`, MIT) wraps Jolt Physics (https://github.com/jrouwe/JoltPhysics), which its CMake
fetches at tag v5.5.0 (`joltc/CMakeLists.txt`) and compiles into the archive in `dist/`.
`JoltPhysics.LICENSE` is that tag's LICENSE (MIT), kept here since the fetched source is not.
